title: Return to Tzalan

verbs.none:
NOTHING TO
DO HERE.
KEEP
EXPLORING.

system.dark:
IT IS TOO
DARK TO SEE.

intro:
A YEAR HAS
PASSED SINCE
YOU WOKE THE
CITY OF
TZALAN.

NOW ROURKE,
A GREEDY
RIVAL, HAS
STOLEN THE
STAR STONE.

THE CITY
GROWS DIM.
THE FIRE
MOUNTAIN
RUMBLES.

QUEEN IXA
HAS SENT
FOR YOU.

GOOD LUCK,
EXPLORER.

cells.name: Royal garden
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE ROYAL
GARDEN.
cells.look:
AN OLD RED
PARROT SITS
ON A PERCH.
YOU KNOW
THAT PARROT!

talk.no:
THE PARROT
SQUAWKS:
"CONDOR
LIKES MUSIC!
FEATHER
OPENS THE
SKY!"

cells.name: Throne room
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE THRONE
ROOM OF
TZALAN.
cells.look:
QUEEN IXA
SITS ON THE
THRONE.
ABOVE HER,
THE STAR
HOLLOW IS
EMPTY.

talk.no:
"ROURKE
STOLE THE
STAR! SET IT
IN THE SKY
TEMPLE, ON
THE FIRE
MOUNTAIN,
AND THE
MOUNTAIN
WILL SLEEP."

cells.name: Pell's house
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
PROFESSOR
PELL'S
HOUSE.
cells.look:
YOUR OLD
FRIEND PELL
WAVES. AN
OIL LAMP
HANGS BY THE
DOOR.

take.text:
"TAKE MY
LAMP," SAYS
PELL. "YOU
WILL NEED
IT."

talk.no:
"ROURKE WENT
UPRIVER BY
BOAT. THE
FISHERFOLK
WILL HAVE
SEEN HIM."

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE AN
OIL LAMP.

cells.name: Great plaza
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE GREAT
PLAZA. IT IS
BUSY!
cells.look:
PEOPLE HURRY
BY. FAR TO
THE SOUTH,
SMOKE RISES
FROM THE
FIRE
MOUNTAIN.

cells.name: Market
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE BUSY
MARKET.
cells.look:
A TRADER
SITS AMONG
POTS AND
FLUTES.
"CACAO! I
TRADE FOR
CACAO!"

give.text:
THE TRADER
GRINS AND
HANDS YOU A
CLAY FLUTE.

talk.no:
"CACAO IS
MONEY HERE,
FRIEND.
BRING ME
SOME AND
PICK ANY
FLUTE YOU
LIKE."

verbs.text:
SOMEONE HERE
WANTS SOME
CACAO.
THEN TAKE A
CLAY FLUTE.

cells.name: Healing temple
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE TEMPLE
OF HEALING.
cells.look:
A PRIEST
BURNS SWEET
HERBS.

talk.no:
"THE FIRE
MOUNTAIN IS
ANGRY. UP
THERE, THE
CONDORS
ANSWER THE
OLD SONGS."

cells.name: Weavers' street
cells.desc:
YOU WALK
DOWN THE
WEAVERS'
STREET.
cells.look:
LOOMS CLACK.
A WEAVER
SAYS THE
WARMEST
CLOAKS ARE
MADE BY A
HERMIT ON
THE
MOUNTAIN.

cells.name: City gate
cells.desc:
YOU STAND AT
THE GREAT
GATE OF
TZALAN.
cells.look:
THE GATE YOU
OPENED A
YEAR AGO.
JUNGLE
STRETCHES
AWAY TO THE
WEST.

cells.name: Cacao garden
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A
CACAO
GARDEN.
cells.look:
THE TREES
HAVE BEEN
PICKED BARE.
THE EARTH
UNDER ONE
TREE LOOKS
FRESHLY
TURNED.

verbs.text:
YOU DIG IN
THE SOFT
EARTH AND
FIND A SACK
OF CACAO
BEANS!
TRY TO DIG.

cells.name: Docks
cells.desc:
YOU ARE AT
THE RIVER
DOCKS.
cells.look:
A CANOE
WAITS FOR
YOU, BUT IT
HAS NO
PADDLE.

use.text:
YOU PUSH OFF
INTO THE
BROWN RIVER.

alt.look:
YOUR CANOE
IS TIED UP,
READY TO GO.

verbs.text:
USE A PADDLE
HERE.

cells.name: Ball court
cells.desc:
YOU ARE AT
THE BALL
COURT.
cells.look:
CHILDREN
PLAY BALL,
USING AN OLD
CANOE PADDLE
AS A BAT.

talk.no:
"WE'LL SWAP
OUR BAT FOR
A SONG!"
THEY SHOUT.

verbs.text:
YOU PLAY A
MERRY TUNE.
THE CHILDREN
DANCE AND
GIVE YOU THE
PADDLE!
TRY TO PLAY.

cells.name: River bend
cells.desc:
YOU PADDLE
ROUND A WIDE
BEND IN THE
RIVER.
cells.look:
TZALAN'S
TOWERS ARE
BEHIND YOU.
THE RIVER
RUNS SOUTH
AND EAST.

door.text:
YOU CAN'T GO
ANYWHERE
WITHOUT A
PADDLE.

cells.name: Fishing village
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A
FISHING
VILLAGE ON
STILTS.
cells.look:
NETS DRY IN
THE SUN. ONE
OLD NET
LOOKS SPARE.

talk.no:
"A MAN IN A
MOTORBOAT
WENT BY. THE
CROCODILES
UPRIVER ATE
HIS SUPPER!
THEY LOVE
FISH."

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE AN
OLD NET.

cells.name: Sandbar
cells.desc:
YOU BEACH
THE CANOE ON
A SANDBAR.
cells.look:
SILVER FISH
LEAP IN THE
SHALLOWS.

verbs.text:
YOU WADE IN
WITH THE NET
AND SCOOP UP
A FAT FISH!
verbs.fail:
YOU SPLASH
ABOUT, BUT
THE FISH ARE
TOO QUICK.
verbs.done:
YOU HAVE ALL
THE FISH YOU
NEED.

verbs.text: TRY TO SWIM.

cells.name: Whirlpool
cells.desc:
THE
WHIRLPOOL
GRABS YOUR
CANOE AND
SPINS YOU
DOWN, DOWN,
DOWN...

cells.name: Rapids
cells.desc:
YOU FIGHT
YOUR WAY UP
THE RAPIDS.
cells.look:
WHITE WATER
EVERYWHERE.
TO THE WEST
THE RIVER
SPINS IN A
DEADLY
WHIRLPOOL!

cells.name: Turtle beach
cells.desc:
YOU ARE ON A
QUIET BEACH.
cells.look:
TURTLES DOZE
IN THE SUN.
ONE OPENS AN
EYE, THEN
CLOSES IT
AGAIN.

cells.name: Crocodile bank
cells.desc:
YOU REACH A
MUDDY BANK.
cells.look:
HUGE
CROCODILES
LIE ACROSS
THE CHANNEL
SOUTH, JAWS
OPEN.

give.text:
YOU TOSS THE
FISH. THE
CROCODILES
FIGHT OVER
IT AND SLIDE
AWAY!

alt.look:
THE
CROCODILES
ARE BUSY
WITH THE
FISH. THE
CHANNEL IS
CLEAR.

verbs.text:
SOMEONE HERE
WANTS A
FISH.

cells.name: Upper landing
cells.desc:
YOU REACH A
LANDING FAR
UPRIVER.
cells.look:
ROURKE'S
MOTORBOAT
SITS HERE,
OUT OF FUEL.
A COIL OF
ROPE LIES IN
IT.

door.text:
THE
CROCODILES
SNAP AT YOUR
CANOE.

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE
SOME ROPE.

cells.name: Mangroves
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE
MANGROVES.
cells.look:
TWISTED
ROOTS AND
EMPTY FUEL
CANS. ROURKE
WAS IN A
HURRY.

cells.name: Heron marsh
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A
QUIET MARSH.
cells.look:
WHITE HERONS
STALK THE
REEDS. THE
FIRE
MOUNTAIN
SMOKES TO
THE SOUTH.

cells.name: Foothill trail
cells.desc:
A TRAIL
CLIMBS INTO
THE
FOOTHILLS.
cells.look:
THE AIR IS
COOLER.
CLOUDS HANG
IN THE TREES
AHEAD.

cells.name: Hermit's hut
cells.desc:
YOU FIND A
HERMIT'S
HUT.
cells.look:
AN OLD
HERMIT SITS
WEAVING A
THICK WOOL
CLOAK.

give.text:
"MY LUCKY
FROG! HERE,
TAKE THE
CLOAK. STAY
WARM!"

talk.no:
"BRR, IT'S
COLD ON THE
MOUNTAIN!
I'D SWAP MY
CLOAK FOR A
LUCKY JADE
FROG."

verbs.text:
SOMEONE HERE
WANTS A JADE
FROG.
THEN TAKE A
WOOL CLOAK.

cells.name: Jaguar den
cells.desc:
YOU ARE AT A
JAGUAR'S
DEN!
cells.look:
A HUGE
JAGUAR LIES
ACROSS THE
OLD MINE
PATH SOUTH.
IT GROWLS.

verbs.text:
YOU PLAY A
SOFT
LULLABY. THE
JAGUAR YAWNS
AND PADS OFF
INTO THE
TREES.
verbs.fail:
THE JAGUAR
GROWLS. YOU
BACK AWAY.

verbs.text: TRY TO PLAY.

cells.name: Orchid glade
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A
GLADE OF
ORCHIDS.
cells.look:
PURPLE
FLOWERS. PAW
PRINTS LEAD
WEST.

cells.name: Cloud forest
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A
MISTY CLOUD
FOREST.
cells.look:
MOSS DRIPS
FROM EVERY
BRANCH. YOU
HEAR WATER
TO THE EAST.

cells.name: Waterfall pool
cells.desc:
YOU ARE
BESIDE A
DEEP POOL.
cells.look:
A WATERFALL
POURS INTO
THE POOL.
SOMETHING
GREEN GLINTS
AT THE
BOTTOM.

verbs.text:
YOU DIVE TO
THE BOTTOM
AND COME UP
WITH A JADE
FROG!
verbs.done:
THE WATER IS
COLD AND
CLEAR.

verbs.text: TRY TO SWIM.

cells.name: Fern hollow
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A
HOLLOW FULL
OF GIANT
FERNS.
cells.look:
A CARVED
STONE SHOWS
A CONDOR
CARRYING A
STAR. SMOKE
RISES FROM A
HUT NORTH.

cells.name: Old mine
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
AN OLD
SILVER MINE.
cells.look:
RUSTY TOOLS
LIE ABOUT.
ONE PICKAXE
IS STILL
GOOD.

door.text:
THE JAGUAR
WON'T LET
YOU PASS.

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE A
PICKAXE.

dark.text:
IT IS PITCH
DARK IN THE
MINE.

cells.name: Hanging bridge
cells.desc:
YOU ARE AT A
HANGING
BRIDGE.
cells.look:
THE BRIDGE
OVER THE
GORGE IS
CUT! SOMEONE
CUT IT ON
PURPOSE.

use.text:
YOU LASH THE
BRIDGE BACK
TOGETHER. IT
WILL HOLD.

alt.look:
YOUR KNOTS
HOLD THE
BRIDGE FIRM.

verbs.text:
USE SOME
ROPE HERE.

cells.name: Mine shaft
cells.desc:
YOU ARE AT
THE BOTTOM
OF A SHAFT.
cells.look:
OLD CARTS
AND BROKEN
LADDERS. THE
SILVER RAN
OUT LONG
AGO.

cells.name: Rourke's camp
cells.desc:
YOU FIND
ROURKE'S
CAMP.
cells.look:
A TORN TENT
AND A NOTE:
"GONE INSIDE
THE
MOUNTAIN.
THE STAR
WILL MAKE ME
KING!" A
WATER JAR
LIES NEARBY.

take.text:
YOU TAKE THE
JAR. IT IS
FULL OF
WATER.

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE A
WATER JAR.

cells.name: Ash fields
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
FIELDS OF
GREY ASH.
cells.look:
NOTHING
GROWS. THE
MOUNTAIN
RUMBLES
UNDER YOUR
FEET.

cells.name: Hot springs
cells.desc:
YOU FIND
STEAMING HOT
SPRINGS.
cells.look:
BUBBLING
POOLS OF
WARM WATER.

verbs.text:
AHH! YOU
SOAK IN THE
WARM WATER.
LOVELY, BUT
THE MOUNTAIN
WON'T WAIT.

cells.name: Lava field
cells.desc:
YOU ARE ON
AN OLD LAVA
FIELD.
cells.look:
BLACK ROCK,
CRACKED AND
TWISTED. IT
IS STILL
WARM.

cells.name: Snow line
cells.desc:
YOU REACH
THE SNOW
LINE.
cells.look:
AN ICY WIND
HOWLS DOWN
FROM THE
RIDGE ABOVE.
YOU WOULD
FREEZE UP
THERE.

use.text:
YOU WRAP
YOURSELF IN
THE WARM
CLOAK. NOW
YOU CAN FACE
THE WIND.

alt.look:
SNUG IN YOUR
CLOAK, YOU
CAN CLIMB
THE RIDGE.

verbs.text:
USE A WOOL
CLOAK HERE.

cells.name: Obsidian ridge
cells.desc:
YOU ARE ON A
RIDGE OF
BLACK GLASS.
cells.look:
WIND AND
SNOW. STAIRS
CLIMB WEST.
SMOKE POURS
FROM CRACKS
TO THE
SOUTH.

door.text:
THE ICY WIND
DRIVES YOU
BACK.

cells.name: Condor nest
cells.desc:
YOU ARE NEAR
A CONDOR'S
NEST.
cells.look:
A GREAT
CONDOR
WATCHES YOU
FROM ITS
ROCKY NEST.

verbs.text:
YOU PLAY THE
OLD SONG.
THE CONDOR
CIRCLES DOWN
AND DROPS A
LONG FEATHER
AT YOUR
FEET!
verbs.done:
THE CONDOR
NODS ITS
GREAT HEAD.

verbs.text: TRY TO PLAY.

cells.name: Smoke vents
cells.desc:
YOU ARE
AMONG
SMOKING
VENTS.
cells.look:
HOT GAS
HISSES FROM
CRACKS.
FALLEN ROCKS
BLOCK A
TUNNEL INTO
THE
MOUNTAIN.

alt.look:
A GLOWING
TUNNEL LEADS
DOWN INTO
THE
MOUNTAIN.

verbs.text:
YOU DIG
THROUGH THE
FALLEN
ROCKS. A
TUNNEL LEADS
DOWN INTO
THE
MOUNTAIN!
verbs.fail:
THE ROCKS
ARE TOO BIG
TO MOVE BY
HAND.

verbs.text: TRY TO DIG.

cells.name: Sky altar
cells.desc:
YOU STAND AT
THE SKY
ALTAR.
cells.look:
A
STAR-SHAPED
HOLLOW IS
CARVED INTO
THE ALTAR,
OPEN TO THE
SKY.

use.text:
YOU SET THE
STAR ON THE
ALTAR.
STARLIGHT
POURS DOWN.
THE MOUNTAIN
SLEEPS. FAR
AWAY, TZALAN
CHEERS!

verbs.text:
USE A STAR
STONE HERE.

cells.name: Sky temple
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE SKY
TEMPLE.
cells.look:
CLOUDS DRIFT
THROUGH THE
OPEN ROOF.
AN ALTAR
WAITS TO THE
NORTH.

cells.name: Sky gate
cells.desc:
YOU STAND
BEFORE THE
SKY GATE.
cells.look:
A GATE OF
WHITE STONE.
A CARVED
CONDOR HOLDS
AN EMPTY
SLOT FOR A
FEATHER.

use.text:
YOU SET THE
FEATHER IN
THE SLOT.
THE SKY GATE
SWINGS OPEN!

verbs.text:
USE A
FEATHER
HERE.

cells.name: Crater rim
cells.desc:
YOU ARE ON
THE RIM OF
THE CRATER.
cells.look:
FAR BELOW,
THE LAVA
GLOWS AND
BUBBLES. A
CHIMNEY
LEADS DOWN.

cells.name: Sky stairs
cells.desc:
YOU CLIMB
STAIRS CUT
INTO THE
MOUNTAIN.
cells.look:
THE STAIRS
CLIMB NORTH
INTO THE
CLOUDS. A
PATH LEADS
WEST TO THE
CRATER.

cells.name: Collapsed tunnel
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A
COLLAPSED
TUNNEL.
cells.look:
ROCKS FILL
THE TUNNEL.
A VOICE
CALLS:
"HELP! I'M
TRAPPED!"

talk.no:
"IT'S
ROURKE! DIG
ME OUT,
PLEASE! I'LL
GIVE BACK
THE STAR, I
SWEAR!"

verbs.text:
YOU DIG AWAY
THE ROCKS.
ROURKE
CRAWLS OUT,
COUGHING.
verbs.fail:
THE ROCKS
ARE TOO
HEAVY FOR
YOUR HANDS.

verbs.text: TRY TO DIG.

dark.text:
IT IS PITCH
DARK.
SOMEONE
COUGHS
NEARBY.

cells.name: Magma lake
cells.desc:
THE FLOOR
CRUMBLES.
YOU FALL
INTO A LAKE
OF MOLTEN
ROCK!

cells.name: Lava tubes
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
GLOWING LAVA
TUBES.
cells.look:
RED LIGHT
EVERYWHERE.
THE TUNNEL
WEST GLOWS
WHITE HOT.
DON'T GO
THAT WAY!

cells.name: Fire bridge
cells.desc:
YOU CROSS A
NARROW
BRIDGE OF
STONE.
cells.look:
LAVA FLOWS
FAR BELOW.
THE BRIDGE
LEADS EAST
INTO
DARKNESS.

cells.name: Hall of echoes
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE HALL OF
ECHOES.
cells.look:
YOUR VOICE
ECHOES BACK.
SOMEONE IS
CALLING FOR
HELP TO THE
NORTH!

dark.text:
HOT WIND
BLOWS OUT
YOUR LAMP.
IT IS DARK!

cells.name: Ancient forge
cells.desc:
YOU FIND AN
ANCIENT
FORGE.
cells.look:
ANVILS AND
MOULDS,
STILL WARM
FROM THE
LAVA. STAR
SHAPES ARE
CARVED ON
EVERYTHING.

cells.name: Crystal geode
cells.desc:
YOU ARE
INSIDE A
GIANT GEODE.
cells.look:
CRYSTALS
GLOW SOFTLY
IN THE
WALLS. ONE
LOOKS LOOSE.

verbs.text:
YOU DIG OUT
A GLOWING
CRYSTAL. IT
SHINES WITH
ITS OWN
LIGHT!
verbs.fail:
YOU CAN'T
PRY IT OUT
WITH YOUR
FINGERS.
verbs.done:
THE WALL
SPARKLES
WHERE THE
CRYSTAL WAS.

verbs.text: TRY TO DIG.

cells.name: Golden hoard
cells.desc:
GOLD! YOU
FILL YOUR
PACK AND
RUN. THE
MOUNTAIN
ROARS. YOU
ARE RICH,
BUT TZALAN
SLEEPS
FOREVER.

cells.name: Rourke's ledge
cells.desc:
YOU ARE ON A
LEDGE ABOVE
THE LAVA.
cells.look:
ROURKE
SLUMPS HERE,
HUGGING THE
STAR STONE.
GOLD
GLITTERS IN
A TUNNEL
WEST.

take.text:
THE STAR
STONE GLOWS
WARM IN YOUR
HAND.

give.text:
ROURKE
DRINKS. "YOU
SAVED MY
LIFE. HERE,
TAKE THE
STAR. I'M
SORRY."

talk.no:
"WATER... I
NEED
WATER..."
THEN HE
WHISPERS:
"FORGET THE
STAR. TAKE
THE GOLD
WEST AND
RUN!"

alt.look:
ROURKE
RESTS. GOLD
GLITTERS TO
THE WEST,
BUT THE STAR
IS WHAT
MATTERS.

verbs.text:
SOMEONE HERE
WANTS A
WATER JAR.
THEN TAKE A
STAR STONE.

cells.name: Lava chimney
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A
LAVA
CHIMNEY.
cells.look:
OLD
HANDHOLDS
CLIMB UP
TOWARD THE
CRATER RIM.

print.story:
A year ago you found the lost city of Tzalan and woke its kings. Now the star stone is gone, stolen by Rourke, a greedy treasure hunter, and the fire mountain to the south has begun to rumble.

Queen Ixa has sent for you. Follow Rourke up the river, through the cloud forest and into the mountain itself. Set the star in the Sky Temple before it is too late.
print.notes:
Talk to everyone: the people of Tzalan want to help. You can SWIM, DIG and PLAY music; try them wherever they make sense. If you get stuck, try HINT.

There is more than one way for this story to end. Only one of them is the best.

The game is long. Use CODE to save your place.
